Title: Question and tentative answer - Rise of the Nephtali

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This was asked to me (by Greg Pettigrew):

An Independent vampire (say, Hazimel) takes the action to become Liaison.
Then, Hazimel becomes Sabbat (say, Hannibal got a few skill cards and wanted
to Derange him).

A smaller Independent vampire (Jan Pieterzoon Advanced) then takes the action
to become Liaison.

By the rules, they both must auto-yield. Liaison is a sect-based title, and
Jan is a younger vampire.

My answer is that Jan wins, since the "I'm no longer eligible for this title"
auto-yielding takes precedence.

Am I correct?
Is my reason correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.

> Is my reason correct?

The auto-yield from card text on Rise of the Nephtali doesn't come into
play, since the condition for that yield doesn't arise. The title "would
not be contested" since Hazimel isn't Independent.
